job.title: Technology Resilience Analyst (DR/BCP)
job.description:
• Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Program
  • Cloud Engineering focus
  • Brisbane Based, Hybrid working (50%)

We are looking for a practical, detail-focused Technology Resilience Analyst to join a large enterprise environment on an initial 6-month contract. In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring critical cloud technology services remain reliable, recoverable, and ready to withstand disruptive events. This role is about making sure recovery plans actually work in practice. You will partner with technical, project, and business teams to map dependencies, run disaster recovery rehearsals, and embed resilience early across cloud migrations and change initiatives.

What you will be doing:
  • Plan & Document: Develop and maintain practical Technology Recovery Plans (TRPs), application resilience profiles, and dependency maps for critical cloud services.
  • Test & Rehearse: Coordinate disaster recovery exercises, simulations, and rehearsals from end to end, capturing evidence, reporting results, and driving lessons learned.
  • Validate & Assess: Conduct Business Impact Assessments (BIAs) and risk assessments to validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs), Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs), and service criticality.
  • Embed Resilience: Provide hands-on resilience guidance and assurance across active projects, cloud migrations, and supplier assessments to catch gaps early in the lifecycle.
  • Track & Report: Monitor resilience risks, audit findings, and remediation actions, building clear dashboards and governance reporting to track readiness and maturity.
What you bring to the table:
  • Proven experience across cloud engineering, IT operations, disaster recovery (DR) , business continuity planning (BCP), ITSM or technology risk and assurance within complex enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on track record of writing, maintaining, and testing Technology Recovery Plans and recovery procedures.
  • Solid grasp of core resilience concepts, including RTOs, RPOs, service dependencies, backup and restoration, and non-functional requirements.
  • Working knowledge of relevant frameworks and standards such as ISO 2230, ISO 27031 and ITIL.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to run workshops and bridge the gap between technical engineers, suppliers, and business leads.
  • Tertiary qualifications in IT, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
